color.note: One set of colours, Graphite, whatever a device is set to. Colour is a signature: lime is the community and its Signal, blue the evidence, each of the twelve agents its own hue; everything else is graphite and near-white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground of every page and of Sig's window (--ink, --paper, --os-win in code).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, plates, fields and the read strip on surface (--card, --surface).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Sig's title bar and floating panels: search results, menus, pickers (--os-bar, --raised).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: The side panel, the foot of a window, the terminal blocks (--os-side, --band, --ink-3).

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Round the window: the gap that frames it on a desktop, and the status bar's ground (--os-page, --os-stat).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Words and headlines on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (15:1 and up). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary words, ledes, inactive places on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (7.5:1 and up).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, kickers, timestamps, the path line on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (5:1 and up).

tokens.name: text-read
tokens.usage: The words of an answer or of any block an agent signed, a table's reading text, a little under text so the agent's name and the numbers lead (13:1 on surface).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A row under the pointer, the row that is open or picked: a side panel place, a result under the prompt, a roster agent, a row of the Signal board.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: window and card frames, dividers. Decorative, under 3:1 on purpose: a frame never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Borders of hairline buttons and fields. About 1.8:1 on surface, below 3:1: kept as the source has it, the control's own words carry it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one main action per view: the white button's fill (#FFFFFF on hover). Never two on a screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Words on accent (16:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The community and its Signal only: the live dot, scores and moves up, points, the community's place and tab. Never a button fill. As text on surface, 16:1.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: The evidence only: grades, the evidence meter, the rungs in a print, the Library's mark. As text on surface, 8:1.

tokens.name: safety
tokens.usage: The Safety agent: the "safety on" dot, a caution's bead in a print. As text on surface, 6.9:1.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: A Signal's move down, a worse outcome, as text on surface and surface-raised (9:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The preview's banner ground (with on-accent words, 10:1) and a mixed read. Not a brand colour.

tokens.name: agent-safety
tokens.usage: The Safety agent: first to read, last to check. Its glyph, its step in a run, its arc of the ring.

tokens.name: agent-planner
tokens.usage: The Planner: turns goals into measures.

tokens.name: agent-recommender
tokens.usage: The Recommender: finds and reads the fact sheets.

tokens.name: agent-community
tokens.usage: The community: member and forum reports.

tokens.name: agent-combination
tokens.usage: The Combination agent: overlap, or different paths.

tokens.name: agent-markers
tokens.usage: The Markers agent: blood tests pushed two ways.

tokens.name: agent-synergy
tokens.usage: The Synergy auditor: checks it all with your medicines.

tokens.name: agent-evidence
tokens.usage: The Evidence librarian: finds every study result.

tokens.name: agent-relatives
tokens.usage: The Relatives agent: evidence from close relatives.

tokens.name: agent-mechanism
tokens.usage: The Mechanism agent: how each one could work.

tokens.name: agent-builder
tokens.usage: The Stack builder: lays out options to discuss. Also My Miracle's mark.

tokens.name: agent-interpretation
tokens.usage: The Interpretation agent, at the ring's centre: efficacy, reasoned last. White, every colour at once.

tokens.name: op-is
tokens.usage: A print's bead: the compound acts there.

tokens.name: op-up
tokens.usage: A print's bead: raises. Told apart by hue and by the legend's words, never by hue alone.

tokens.name: op-down
tokens.usage: A print's bead: lowers.

tokens.name: op-block
tokens.usage: A print's bead: blocks.

tokens.name: op-watch
tokens.usage: A print's bead: worth a blood test.

tokens.name: op-warn
tokens.usage: A print's bead: a caution, always outermost, ringed in surface.

families.display: "Mona Sans Display", "Mona Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The front page's one headline, and the story page's (clamp 38–64px), Mona Sans at its normal width, tracked -0.03em.

styles.name: page
styles.usage: A page's h1 (clamp 30–40px), ending in a full stop: "BPC-157.", "The Signal."

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Headings inside a page and a card's title on the front page (20–22px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Your report moves the number for the next person, even if it did nothing.
styles.usage: Under a headline, in text-2, at most 50ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Behind every answer are twelve agents, each with one job, each signing what it made.

styles.name: body-app
styles.sample: What members took and how it went.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, a post's title (17.5px in the feed).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: A row of the side panel: a place, a menu item.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, sentence case, verb first (14px on a small button).

styles.name: read
styles.usage: An answer's words and anything an agent signed, in text-read.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: A note under a block, a step under a commit.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: A comment over a headline: // what this is, lowercase, in muted. No capitals, no rule.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, a table's column heads, a pip's words, the bar of a pane.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tables and numbers, tabular figures: the Signal's top table, scores, counts.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Run logs, tails and prompts: step · agent · ✓ · what it did, the agent in its colour.

styles.name: status
styles.sample: safety on · no doses · no sellers · no diagnosis
styles.usage: The status bar's segments and the window's tabs (12px).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: A total on a board: live signals, reports, moves, members; the ring's count.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: A Signal standing on its own, in text with the community's lime pip beside it.

spacing.note: The window's own measures. Inside a page, padding follows the component's spec.

tokens.name: window-gap
tokens.usage: The page-coloured gap round Sig's window on a desktop (0 on a phone).

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: The padding inside a window's body in the community. On the site's pages the side padding is 40px (20px from 701 to 900px wide, 16px on a phone), the same for the page, its foot and the path line; on a phone, 16px everywhere.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Between the feed and the rail in the community.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Between cards in the rail, between a page's blocks.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a status bar segment, a table cell (10px on narrow screens).

size.note: Fixed sizes of the window's parts.

tokens.name: side-panel
tokens.usage: The side panel's width; on a phone a drawer of min(86vw, 300px).

tokens.name: title-bar
tokens.usage: Sig's title bar on the site (52px on a phone, so its controls are 40px targets); 52px in the community, where search and your things sit in it.

tokens.name: path-line
tokens.usage: The path line's least height, under the title bar.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: The status bar at the window's foot.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A row of the side panel: one of the four places, or a menu item.

tokens.name: row-more
tokens.usage: A row of the side panel's quieter "more" list, so the panel fits a 900px-tall screen (40px in the phone drawer).

tokens.name: tab
tokens.usage: A window tab (34px in the community), sitting on the window like a file's tab in an editor.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, chips and small keys: a pip and its words, a status, a filter.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: A tab's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Rows: the side panel's places and menu, a result under the prompt, an agent in the roster; a tall chip.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields, terminal blocks (a run log, the 404 shell).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, plates and tables; Sig's window and its bars' corners.

tokens.name: radius-pane
tokens.usage: The front page's big panes: the prompt, the Signal board, a run, the graph.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Pips, live dots, agent dots, a tab's dot.

shadow.note: Nothing casts a shadow but what floats over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels: search results, menus, pickers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The side panel when it slides in over the page on a phone.
